Instruction: Generate code that uses the pyaedt library to create a flex cable CPWG (coplanar waveguide with ground) in HFSS. The code should first import necessary libraries and set the non-graphical mode. Then, it should launch AEDT in a specified version and solution type, and set some properties such as material override, automatically use causal materials, open region, model units, and initial mesh. 

Next, the code should define variables for the flex cable CPWG, including total length, theta, radius, width, height, spacing, ground width, and ground thickness. It should also define a function to create a bending based on the curvature radius and extension.

The code should then draw a signal line and a ground line to create a bent signal wire and two bent ground wires respectively. It should also draw a dielectric to create a dielectric cable, and create bottom metals. 

Afterwards, the code should create port interfaces (PEC enclosures) and a Perfect E boundary condition. It should also create ports and a setup and sweep with specified properties. 

Finally, the code should plot the model and release AEDT.

```python
from pyaedt import Hfss
from pyaedt import Desktop
import numpy as np

# Set non-graphical mode
non_graphical = True

# Launch AEDT in specified version and solution type
aedt_version = "2024.1"
project_name = "FlexCableCPWG"
design_name = "CPWG_Flex"
solution_type = "DrivenModal"

d = Desktop(aedt_version, non_graphical=non_graphical, new_desktop_session=True)
hfss = Hfss(projectname=project_name, designname=design_name, solution_type=solution_type, specified_version=aedt_version)

# Set properties
hfss.change_material_override(True)
hfss.use_causal_materials = True
hfss.modeler.model_units = "mm"
hfss.modeler.initial_mesh = True
hfss.create_open_region(Frequency="10GHz", boundary="radiation")

# CPWG flex cable variables
total_length = 100  # mm
theta = 90          # degrees, bend angle
radius = 20         # mm, bend radius
width = 2           # mm, signal width
height = 0.2        # mm, signal thickness
spacing = 0.5       # mm, gap between signal and ground
gnd_width = 5       # mm, ground width
gnd_thickness = 0.2 # mm, ground thickness
dielectric_height = 0.5 # mm, dielectric thickness

hfss["total_length"] = "{}mm".format(total_length)
hfss["theta"] = "{}deg".format(theta)
hfss["radius"] = "{}mm".format(radius)
hfss["width"] = "{}mm".format(width)
hfss["height"] = "{}mm".format(height)
hfss["spacing"] = "{}mm".format(spacing)
hfss["gnd_width"] = "{}mm".format(gnd_width)
hfss["gnd_thickness"] = "{}mm".format(gnd_thickness)
hfss["dielectric_height"] = "{}mm".format(dielectric_height)

# Function to create a bent polyline (arc + straight)
def create_bent_polyline(start, direction, length_straight, bend_radius, bend_angle_deg, width, name, mat, is_sheet=False):
    # start: [x, y, z]
    # direction: "x" or "y"
    # length_straight: length before bend
    # bend_radius: radius of bend
    # bend_angle_deg: angle of bend
    # width: width of line
    # name: object name
    # mat: material
    # is_sheet: if True, create sheet, else solid
    pts = []
    if direction == "x":
        pts.append(start)
        pts.append([start[0] + length_straight, start[1], start[2]])
        arc_center = [start[0] + length_straight, start[1] + bend_radius, start[2]]
        arc_start = [start[0] + length_straight, start[1], start[2]]
        arc_end = [arc_center[0] + bend_radius * np.sin(np.deg2rad(bend_angle_deg)),
                   arc_center[1] - bend_radius * (1 - np.cos(np.deg2rad(bend_angle_deg))),
                   start[2]]
        pts.append(arc_end)
    else:
        pts.append(start)
        pts.append([start[0], start[1] + length_straight, start[2]])
        arc_center = [start[0] - bend_radius, start[1] + length_straight, start[2]]
        arc_start = [start[0], start[1] + length_straight, start[2]]
        arc_end = [arc_center[0] + bend_radius * (1 - np.cos(np.deg2rad(bend_angle_deg))),
                   arc_center[1] + bend_radius * np.sin(np.deg2rad(bend_angle_deg)),
                   start[2]]
        pts.append(arc_end)
    poly = hfss.modeler.create_polyline(pts, cover_surface=True, xsection_type="Rectangle", xsection_width=width, name=name)
    if not is_sheet:
        hfss.modeler.thicken_sheet(poly, height if name == "Signal" else gnd_thickness, both_sides=False)
    hfss.modeler.assign_material(poly, mat)
    return poly

# Draw signal line (bent)
signal_start = [0, 0, dielectric_height]
signal = create_bent_polyline(signal_start, "x", total_length/2 - radius, radius, theta, width, "Signal", "copper")

# Draw ground lines (bent, left and right)
gnd_left_start = [0, -spacing - gnd_width, 0]
gnd_right_start = [0, spacing + width, 0]
gnd_left = create_bent_polyline(gnd_left_start, "x", total_length/2 - radius, radius, theta, gnd_width, "GND_Left", "copper")
gnd_right = create_bent_polyline(gnd_right_start, "x", total_length/2 - radius, radius, theta, gnd_width, "GND_Right", "copper")

# Draw dielectric cable
dielectric_length = total_length
dielectric_width = 2 * (gnd_width + spacing)
dielectric = hfss.modeler.create_box([0, -gnd_width - spacing, 0], [dielectric_length, dielectric_width, dielectric_height], name="Dielectric")
hfss.modeler.assign_material(dielectric, "polyimide")

# Create bottom metals (ground plane under signal and grounds)
bottom_gnd = hfss.modeler.create_box([0, -gnd_width - spacing, 0], [dielectric_length, dielectric_width, gnd_thickness], name="BottomGND")
hfss.modeler.assign_material(bottom_gnd, "copper")

# Create port interfaces (PEC enclosures)
pec1 = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(position=[0, -gnd_width - spacing, 0], dimension_list=[dielectric_width, dielectric_height + gnd_thickness], normal=hfss.modeler.AxisDir.XPos, name="PEC1")
pec2 = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(position=[dielectric_length, -gnd_width - spacing, 0], dimension_list=[dielectric_width, dielectric_height + gnd_thickness], normal=hfss.modeler.AxisDir.XPos, name="PEC2")
hfss.modeler.assign_material(pec1, "pec")
hfss.modeler.assign_material(pec2, "pec")

# Assign Perfect E boundary to PEC faces
hfss.assign_perfecte_to_sheets([pec1, pec2])

# Create ports
port1 = hfss.create_wave_port_from_two_conductors(signal, bottom_gnd, pec1, portname="Port1", integration_line=None)
port2 = hfss.create_wave_port_from_two_conductors(signal, bottom_gnd, pec2, portname="Port2", integration_line=None)

# Create setup and sweep
setup = hfss.create_setup("Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "10GHz"
setup.props["MaximumPasses"] = 10
setup.props["MinimumPasses"] = 1
setup.props["MinimumConvergedPasses"] = 1
setup.props["PercentRefinement"] = 30
setup.props["BasisOrder"] = 1
setup.props["MinimumFrequency"] = "1GHz"
setup.props["MaximumDeltaS"] = 0.01
setup.update()

sweep = setup.add_sweep()
sweep.props["RangeType"] = "LinearStep"
sweep.props["RangeStart"] = "1GHz"
sweep.props["RangeEnd"] = "20GHz"
sweep.props["RangeStep"] = "0.1GHz"
sweep.update()

# Plot the model
hfss.plot(show=True)

# Release AEDT
hfss.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
